purpose: Teach: 微分/散らし/弁明/欺瞞/排泄/捕鯨/抗争/殺戮

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、微分方程式の社会応用を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on the practical applications of differential equations in society.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Slight lift on his name — encouraging without being patronizing. Genuinely curious. Steady pace, teacher-to-student but meeting him at eye level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、チラシを散らした選挙運動の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the history of electoral campaigns that distributed flyers widely.
lines.style: Clear and direct, slightly careful. Ren choosing his words precisely. A beat of hesitation — checking whether his answer matches what she asked. Quiet earnestness underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、政治家の弁明の修辞を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you wrote about the rhetoric politicians use to defend themselves.
lines.style: Gently probing, not accusatory. A teacher recognizing a pattern but giving him space to explain it himself. Warm curiosity. Slight emphasis on 'rhetoric' — she's noticed something worth noting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、宣伝の中の欺瞞表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — specifically the deceptive language patterns used in advertising.
lines.style: Still earnest, but now more confident. Ren meeting her halfway. Not defensive, but clarifying. Direct eye contact in his voice. A small steadiness emerging.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 排泄物処理の都市史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you chose the urban history of sewage management for your focus.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost conspiratorial. She's following his thread, genuinely engaged. A hint of warmth — she sees what he's doing. Observant without judgment. Pace stays steady, conversational.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、国際捕鯨規制の論争を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the international whaling disputes and regulatory conflicts.
lines.style: The pattern more obvious now. Ren answering directly, but there's a quietness underneath — he knows she's noticed. Not ashamed, just aware. Pace even, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、二十世紀の暴力団抗争史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on twentieth-century yakuza conflicts — that was quite a choice.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle but direct. She's not criticizing; she's holding up a mirror. Warm intention underneath. A slight pause before 'quite a choice' — giving him room to understand she sees him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の殺戮事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about wartime atrocities and mass casualty incidents.
lines.style: Quieter now. Ren fully present, no evasion. Speaking plainly about difficult things. A closing steadiness — he's finished explaining, and he's at peace with it. Slight warm fadeout.
